title: "Medical AR/MR Visualization in Medicine: Interactive Evidence Map"

```{python}
#| output: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import plotly.express as px
from dash_helpers import load, load_summary, ACCENT

studies = load("studies.csv")
summary = load_summary()
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Studies"
dict(icon="journal-text", color="primary", value=summary["n_studies"])
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Year range"
dict(icon="calendar-range", color="info",
     value=f"{summary['year_min']}–{summary['year_max']}")
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Clinical specialties"
dict(icon="heart-pulse", color="success", value=summary["n_specialties"])
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Display devices"
dict(icon="badge-ar", color="warning", value=summary["n_devices"])
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Imaging modalities"
dict(icon="layers", color="secondary", value=summary["n_modalities"])
```

## Row {height=65%}

```{python}
#| title: Publication trend over time
years = studies["publication_year"].value_counts().sort_index()
fig = px.area(x=years.index, y=years.values)
fig.update_traces(
    line_color=ACCENT,
    hovertemplate="Year %{x}<br>%{y} studies<extra></extra>",
)
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Publication year",
    yaxis_title="Number of studies",
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10),
)
fig
```
